description: This file contains functions for upgrading eMMC storage devices using tar archives or FIT images, including handling kernel and root filesystem partitions, zeroing device areas, and copying configuration data.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for tar archive files containing kernel and root filesystem images, updates device partitions accordingly.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for FIT images, writes kernel to the specified device.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data into eMMC device partitions.
